pattern.description: Path pattern relative to path: * matches within a name, ** any number of folders, {a,b} either; e.g. **/*.go or src/**/*_test.{ts,tsx}.

path.description: Folder to search, relative to the project root or absolute; default the project root.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (Go RE2 syntax), matched against each line.

path.description: File or folder to search, relative to the project root or absolute; default the project root.

include.description: Only files whose path relative to path matches this pattern, e.g. **/*.go or *.{ts,tsx}.

files_only.description: Return only the files that match, not their lines.

context.description: Lines to show before and after each matching line, at most 10.

path.description: File to read, relative to the project root or absolute.

offset.description: First line to read, counting from 1; default 1.

limit.description: How many lines to read; default and at most 2000.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task, shown to the user.

prompt.description: The complete task for the subagent, self-contained.

description.description: One short sentence explaining the impact of this option.

header.description: Short header label shown in the UI (12 or fewer chars).

question.description: Single-sentence prompt shown to the user, in the user's language.

options.description: Optional mutually exclusive choices. The user can always answer in their own words instead.

questions.description: Questions to show the user. Prefer 1 and do not exceed 3.
